    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for row in grid for x in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # repeated unique marker color is the non-background color occurring sparsely outside the motif
    markers=[]
    for color,n in cnt.items():

            # marker set is the repeated color separate from the contiguous patterned object
            if len(pts)==n: markers=pts
    # The pattern is all non-background cells excluding markers; use its bounding box,

    mset=set(markers)

steps.output:
def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for row in grid for x in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # repeated unique marker color is the non-background color occurring sparsely outside the motif
    markers=[]
    for color,n in cnt.items():
        if color != bg and n >= 2:
            pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==color]
            # marker set is the repeated color separate from the contiguous patterned object
            if len(pts)==n and (not markers or n>len(markers)): markers=pts
    # The pattern is all non-background cells excluding markers; use its bounding box,
    # retaining background cells inside that box as part of the stamp.
    mset=set(markers)
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]!=bg and (r,c) not in mset]
    r0=min(r for r,c in pts); r1=max(r for r,c in pts)
    c0=min(c for r,c in pts); c1=max(c for r,c in pts)
    pat=[row[c0:c1+1] for row in grid[r0:r1+1]]
    ar=(r1-r0)//2; ac=(c1-c0)//2
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for mr,mc in markers:
        for dr in range(len(pat)):
            for dc in range(len(pat[0])):
                rr=mr+dr-ar; cc=mc+dc-ac
                if 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w: out[rr][cc]=pat[dr][dc]
    return out
